resources.string: Tap the star to keep a currency at the top of the list. Starred currencies are also the ones your widgets, your watch and the Rates screen show.
Hide what you do not use
Swipe a card away to hide that currency. Hidden currencies come back from the menu.
Each refresh of the rates costs one coin. Tap your balance to top it up.
Tap any circle to convert from that currency, then enter an amount to see what it is worth in the others.
